observations: Photo 0: A hand holds a black Nikon DSLR camera with a lens attached. The camera body has 'Nikon' visible on the top left. The lens has 'Nikon' and 'AF-S DX NIKKOR' engraved on the front ring. The camera is mounted on a strap.

Photo 1: The same camera is shown from a different angle, held up to the ceiling. The lens is clearly labeled 'AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm'. The camera body has 'Nikon' on the top left. The background shows a room with a TV and a fan.
Photo 2: The back of the camera is shown, with the screen off. The 'Nikon' logo is visible on the bottom center. The control buttons and dials are visible. The camera is still on a strap.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI NWOKE BRIGHT'.

claims.claim: Capture beautiful photos and videos with this Nikon D60 DSLR camera
claims.evidence: The camera is shown, but no proof of functionality (photos or videos) is provided. The model 'D60' is not visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording a video.

risks.risk: The lens may have internal damage or scratches not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.

risks.risk: The camera may have a high shutter count (beyond 5,000) or be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo or video taken by the camera.

risks.risk: The camera may be missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, or lens cap).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the camera.

proof_requests: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and recording a video.
A close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light.
A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent photo or video.
A photo showing all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
